name: media
title: Media
description: Use for Consuelo OS media work such as source-preserving image edits, memes, SVG logo overlays, screenshots, clip preparation, and export. Routes meme requests to the nested memes subskill.
trigger: Use when a user wants to find, download, inspect, edit, compose, validate, or export image, meme, SVG, screenshot, audio, or video assets on their OS-connected computer; use the memes subskill for static meme edits.
